cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Apologize to Reality
cards.instruction: Get someone to apologize to an object, rule, place, or idea for violating its impossible expectations.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I bowed to the chair like you. Before your caretaker interview, tell it you're sorry for sitting without permission.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I bent down for a coin. It can't give permission.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Coin safe, yes. Then apologise for taking silence as permission.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Sorry, chair. I'll stand for the interview.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then apologise for making it redundant. You're applying to care for furniture, not leave it without a job.
